description: Ministry of Labour & Trade Union Relations - Industrial Disputes between the Ceylon Estate Staff's Union and Chilaw Plantations Ltd.,
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the exercise of legal/regulatory powers under the Industrial Disputes Act. It contains an official order made by the Minister under Section 4(1) of the Act to appoint an arbitrator for an industrial dispute, which constitutes regulatory action and legal procedure implementation. The content focuses on statutory instruments and legal proceedings rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories.
